title: CE31406: Ground Improvement
text:
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction, ground improvements schemes for cohesive soil sites (preloading,
staged construction, accelerated consolidation with prefabricated drains,
granular columns, lime columns, electro-osmosis, compaction piles, deep mixing,
and vibro-replacement), ground improvement schemes for cohesionless soil sites
(deep dynamic compaction, vibro-compaction, blast densification, grouting, and
jet grouting), mechanically stabilized earthwork, soil nailing, ground anchors,
light weight fill, and monitoring and quality control in ground improvement
projects.
